requirements.text: Compute and publish the "removal of luck" panel on the site dashboard

requirements.text: Add a two-sided "what would change our mind" field to every strategy entry

requirements.text: Price a line ourselves and publish the residual against the market, on a schedule, from day one
requirements.gate: residuals are published for Week 10 and Week 11, but no scheduled re-pricing job exists yet

requirements.text: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it
requirements.clearing_metric: stadium published for all 150 fixtures (T2); the Munich game (NE@DET, W10) verified directly against the official game centre 2026-11-16

requirements.text: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page
requirements.clearing_metric: the Week 16/17/18 flexible-scheduling announcement and its official link are published beside the schedule links on the readiness page

requirements.text: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status; do not infer depth rank or snaps
requirements.gate: per-game Game Book PDF links verified on the official game centre (2026-11-16); PDF ingestion is not built
requirements.clearing_metric: a parsed Game Book per completed game feeding actual starters into the availability graph

requirements.text: Ingest game-level results to make the ratings opponent-aware
requirements.clearing_metric: walk-forward power model and the originated lines both ingest game results (sigma recomputed on 4,056 games 2011-2026 = 12.97)

requirements.text: Add injury and personnel ablations instead of fixed penalties
requirements.detail: Instead of subtracting a fixed number of points for a missing starter, test the same model with and without the personnel features and report the difference with uncertainty.
requirements.gate: ablation needs a multi-week availability feature that does not exist yet (R35/R37 gate)
requirements.clearing_metric: with/without comparison of >= 40 games with bootstrap uncertainty

requirements.text: Add injury/depth ablations, not fixed penalties
requirements.detail: Compare identical models with and without verified availability features using chronological holdouts.
requirements.gate: same gate as R52: no verified multi-week availability series exists to ablate
requirements.clearing_metric: chronological holdout with/without availability features, difference + CI published

requirements.text: Automate immutable multi-day availability snapshots
requirements.detail: Capture the official report and club depth pages at least daily with retained hashes, so practice designations can be replayed as they were known. Today the site holds one capture, which cannot support backtesting.
requirements.gate: gate F-T1 (session 8326a20d): nfl.com Terms §1.3 prohibit systematic retrieval to compile a database without written consent — the schedule is disabled and capture runs only on explicit manual dispatch; club depth pages are not in the first version
requirements.clearing_metric: owner resolves F-T1 (written consent or derived-counts-only policy), then a successful capture run, then daily cadence including club pages

requirements.text: Build immutable official availability snapshots
requirements.detail: Scheduled capture of NFL injury reports, club depth pages and inactive evidence with raw hashes, timestamps and conflict flags
requirements.clearing_metric: append-only ledger with sha256 per capture, conflict flags, and the capture script writing raw hash-stamped HTML

requirements.text: Capture official inactive lists and snap counts
requirements.detail: Only 6 of 254 report rows carry a game designation, and no active list or snap share is captured. Without them a backup's replacement of a starter cannot be confirmed, only suspected.
requirements.gate: snap-count rows exist (265,892 player-weeks) but per-game inactive lists are not captured by any verified source in the repo; note the 6-of-254 state predates the current 345-row captures
requirements.clearing_metric: inactive list for each Week 11 game captured before kickoff, with source URL

requirements.text: Fix the two depth-parsing failures before widening coverage
requirements.detail: The Texans publish depth as an image and the Packers prepend jersey numbers. Number stripping plus storing the raw string recovers the Packers rows; the Texans image needs an authorized structured source, not transcription by eye.
requirements.gate: Packers rows are stored with raw strings in the club chart capture; the Texans chart remains an image, which no authorized structured source covers
requirements.clearing_metric: HOU depth rows from an authorized structured source (route decision in R77)

requirements.text: Model depth slots as groups, not a single starter
requirements.detail: 149 club/unit/position slots list more than one rank-1 player (three receivers at rank 1, three inside linebackers at rank 1). Treating column 1 as 'the starter' would fabricate a starter the club never named.
requirements.gate: the captured charts store positional rank arrays (shared rank-1 players stay in their listed order), but the group-slot model is only implemented for the 5 captured clubs
requirements.clearing_metric: all 32 clubs' charts represented as group slots under one verified route (R77)

requirements.text: Treat roster turnover as a first-class data event
requirements.detail: The Colts' Week 10 release documents two starting-receiver trades in the same article as its depth chart. Depth, availability and lineup evidence must be versioned against the last official roster event, not trusted as durable.
requirements.gate: a dated 2026 transaction table exists in the repo (63 trades, T2 nflverse) but evidence versioning against roster events is not yet implemented
requirements.clearing_metric: ledger rows keyed by last-roster-event date; stale-depth flagger (R71) running

requirements.text: Start with a singles-only shadow baseline
requirements.detail: Pre-register a simple team-strength model, freeze versions and record forecasts before kickoff.
requirements.clearing_metric: STRAT-1 frozen 2026-11-16; 13 Week 11 forecasts recorded 2026-11-16, three days before the Week 11 opener

requirements.text: Keep parlays and prop combos behind a joint-evidence gate
requirements.detail: Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence. A combo may only be ranked when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.
requirements.clearing_metric: the gate is in force: no combo is ranked anywhere in the repo, and the parlay analysis publishes a sensitivity grid over rho rather than a fabricated correlation

requirements.text: Use proper-score leaderboard divisions
requirements.detail: Separate singles, game parlays, same-game parlays and prop combos; rank eligible strategies by benchmark-relative skill with uncertainty.
requirements.gate: divisions defined in the leaderboard spec; the leaderboard itself is not published (zero eligible strategies)
requirements.clearing_metric: a published leaderboard with four divisions and >= 1 eligible strategy in the singles division

requirements.text: Rank with proper scores and uncertainty, not win rate
requirements.detail: Rank by benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment for the number of trials. Raw win rate and short-run ROI cannot distinguish skill from variance.
requirements.gate: Brier skill + Benjamini-Hochberg machinery exists and was run on 11 strategies x 8 gates; the prospective ranking surface does not exist
requirements.clearing_metric: a ranking table computed by the frozen scoring rule on prospective data

requirements.text: Add durable snapshot storage and alerts
requirements.detail: Store immutable captures outside the static site, monitor freshness and alert on source/schema changes.
requirements.gate: immutable captures + freshness monitoring + a loud CI alarm exist; the alarm channel is a failing workflow, not an independent monitor; raw HTML captures are not yet 'outside the static site' in the ownership sense the requirement describes
requirements.clearing_metric: an independent alert on capture age (not only a CI failure) and a storage location the site build cannot overwrite

requirements.text: Split the site into a public analysis layer and a private data layer
requirements.detail: Keep the public site to derived analysis (indices, ratios, model output, links to the official page) and hold raw row-level data in a private store until the terms are read.
requirements.gate: the public site currently serves row-level transcriptions in JSON/CSV; a private store requires infrastructure (a private repo or storage bucket) that only the owner can provision
requirements.clearing_metric: raw row-level data moved to a non-public store; site pages keep indices, ratios and links

requirements.text: Add a per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
requirements.detail: Quick team-level decision view
requirements.clearing_metric: 28 clubs with report rows, Out/Doubtful/Questionable/DNP counts, net injury count, next opponent, and the explicit IR unknown flag; bye clubs excluded with a note

requirements.text: Add an announced-starter evidence field (not an inferred replacement)
requirements.detail: The blank replacement columns are correct for the report page, but the NFL does publish dated starter changes for Lock, McCord and Brissett (VR-24, VR-25; VQ-05).
requirements.gate: the news register carries dated announced-starter headlines with official URLs (e.g. Drew Lock will start); the field is not yet wired into the per-game availability rows
requirements.clearing_metric: announced-starter evidence column populated from official news URLs for every game with a starter change

requirements.text: Add an official depth-chart register with date and source per row
requirements.detail: Required to flag backups replacing starters on offense and defense
requirements.clearing_metric: the depth-chart capture carries source, page date and club disclaimer per club, plus the ledger's sha256-stamped registration

requirements.text: Calibrate what "Questionable" means empirically instead of using old percentages
requirements.detail: Official text gives no percentages
requirements.gate: requires multiple seasons of archived weekly reports joined to inactives/outcomes; no archive is reachable (nflverse/nfldata contains no injury table - verified via GitHub contents API 2026-11-16; release assets unreachable from this environment)
requirements.clearing_metric: >= 3 seasons of designation -> play-rate joins with confidence intervals

requirements.text: Interactive Offense vs. Defense Matchup Deficiency Matrix (1st–4th String)
requirements.detail: Surfaces immediate trench and coverage mismatches (e.g., WR1 facing promoted 2nd/3rd-string CB, or EDGE1 facing 2nd/3rd-string OT/LG) on one screen.
requirements.gate: needs depth order for all 32 clubs on one verified route (R77) — 5 of 32 exist
requirements.clearing_metric: 32/32 clubs with group-slot depth on one verified route

requirements.text: Flag stale depth rows against the official transactions log
requirements.detail: Baltimore still publishes Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley at QB after both went on injured reserve and a replacement was traded in (VR-17, VR-26; VQ-07).
requirements.gate: trade dates and depth-row retrieval dates both exist, but no automated join flags rows older than the last roster event
requirements.clearing_metric: an automated flag on every depth row whose retrieval predates the club's last roster event

requirements.text: Point-in-Time Snapshot Ledger for Injuries, Depth Charts & Inactives
requirements.detail: Prevents lookahead leakage when backtesting originated lines and preserves exact pre-kickoff replacement certainty.
requirements.clearing_metric: append-only ledger with sha256, capture date, source URL, conflict flags, and the replayable-raw design for future captures

requirements.text: Populate the three missing Lions game-status designations
requirements.detail: Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed are published with a blank game-status cell while the official article lists all three as Out (VR-08, VR-12).
requirements.clearing_metric: all three rows carry Out in both committed captures and were re-verified against the live official report on 2026-11-16 (Knee/Ankle/Hip, DNP, Out)

requirements.text: Re-capture and republish the Week 10 injury tables
requirements.detail: Published counts are stale: 254 rows and 4 no-injury sections versus 279 rows and 2 sections live; Seattle and Cincinnati are shown as injury-free while listing 15 and 4 players (VR-04, VR-05, VR-06, VR-07).

requirements.text: Reject: deriving depth order from jersey number, experience or salary
requirements.detail: Proposed shortcut for SG-05: infer starters from roster attributes on the official roster page.
requirements.clearing_metric: rejection recorded as policy: depth order comes only from a verified club chart or snap counts (R77 routes); roster attributes never infer it

requirements.text: Represent shared and empty depth slots faithfully

requirements.gate: the positional-array representation stores shared and empty slots faithfully for the 5 captured clubs; SEA and WAS charts are not among the captured five, so their specific slots remain unverified
requirements.clearing_metric: SEA and WAS charts captured and verified on the same representation

requirements.text: Resolve the depth-order source before building the backup-deficiency feature
requirements.detail: Evaluate two routes in order: (a) per-club official depth chart pages, verified club by club; (b) derive depth from snap counts if an official snap-count source exists. Do not build the feature until one route is verified for all 32 clubs.
requirements.gate: route evaluation is documented; 5 of 32 clubs verified on route (a); no official 32-club snap-count route exists yet
requirements.clearing_metric: one route verified for 32/32 clubs, recorded club by club

requirements.text: Score injury-designation reliability before using it as a feature
requirements.detail: Join several seasons of designations to the official inactive lists and measure the play rate per designation with confidence intervals. Only then decide whether the label becomes a model feature.
requirements.gate: same source gate as R69: seasons of archived designations + inactive lists are not reachable
requirements.clearing_metric: play rate per designation with CI over >= 3 seasons

requirements.text: Snapshot the nfl.com injury report every Wed, Thu and Fri and keep a dated history

requirements.gate: workflow committed with hash-stamped history but the schedule is disabled pending gate F-T1 (nfl.com Terms §1.3); capture is manual-dispatch only until the owner decides
requirements.clearing_metric: owner resolves F-T1; then three dated captures in the history with a published delta

requirements.text: Treat the injury report as a timestamped series, not a weekly snapshot
requirements.detail: Capture the report daily from Wednesday to kickoff with the fetch timestamp, then measure how designations evolve.
requirements.gate: the series design exists (ledger + capture); the series itself begins at the first automated capture
requirements.clearing_metric: >= 3 timestamped reads of one week's report with an evolution measure

requirements.text: Use snap counts as the starter proxy when the depth chart is unavailable
requirements.detail: Gives a measurable starter/backup split
requirements.gate: snap table exists (265,892 rows) but the starter-proxy join (top snap share per unit per week) is not built
requirements.clearing_metric: published per-unit snap-share leaders for the current week

requirements.text: Add a control baseline (random picks; favorites only) to every leaderboard run
requirements.detail: Separates skill from luck
requirements.clearing_metric: frozen-seed random baseline (54.05% on 148 games) and favourites-only baseline (SU 68.24%, cover 52.03%, cover band asserted) computed on the verified corpus

requirements.text: Stadium Roof/Surface & NWS Hourly Wind/Precipitation Overlay
requirements.detail: Prevents totals and passing-prop mispricing by coupling NWS forecast grids with official 90-minute stadium roof designations.
requirements.gate: roof/surface published for all 150 fixtures; NWS hourly grids are unreachable from the build environment (weather.gov not on the allow-list)
requirements.clearing_metric: weather.gov reachable from CI, then hourly wind/precip joined to roof designations

requirements.text: Two-Stage Skill Leaderboard (Proper-Score Qualification -> Prospective CLV/ROI Escrow)
requirements.detail: Aligns incentives strictly with calibrated probabilistic skill (Brier Skill Score + Closing Line Value) over multi-week prospective samples.
requirements.gate: stage 1 qualification is specified; stage 2 needs prospective CLV, which needs price snapshots over time (R26 series) and a leaderboard (R62 gate)
requirements.clearing_metric: stage-2 escrow panel with >= 4 weeks of prospective CLV data

requirements.text: Vig-Free Market Consensus vs. Originated Fair-Line Decomposition View
requirements.detail: Separates true pricing divergence (origination alpha) from operator vig/margin before any bet structure is considered.
requirements.gate: vig-free moneyline normalisation is defined in policy P5 and single-book vig-free residuals are computable; a multi-book CONSENSUS needs prices from several books, which no reachable source provides
requirements.clearing_metric: >= 2 independent book prices per game, enabling a consensus column

requirements.text: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot
requirements.detail: Store each weekly snapshot and render a diff column (rank change, rating change, availability change).
requirements.gate: the snapshot ledger defines the delta mechanism; weekly diffs need >= 2 weekly snapshots
requirements.clearing_metric: first weekly diff published from two dated snapshots

requirements.text: Publish every model total twice until one wins
requirements.detail: Keep both estimators visible with the gap column, and only collapse to one after a walk-forward comparison.
requirements.gate: a second total estimator must be built and pre-registered before the two can be compared
requirements.clearing_metric: two pre-registered estimators with a gap column over >= 40 games

requirements.text: Add a drift alarm to every scraper
requirements.detail: Pin each parser to expected row counts and required fields; fail the build loudly when a field goes missing rather than publishing a blank.
requirements.clearing_metric: seven datasets pinned to row counts + required fields + max capture age (exit 1 on violation); the report parser fails loudly on missing markers

requirements.text: Capture the reserve list so 'not listed' never means 'available'
requirements.detail: Malik Willis is absent from the weekly report because he is on injured reserve, not because he is healthy (VR-25; VQ-06).
requirements.gate: same gate as R38: no verified source carries reserve/IR status in this environment; every team row carries the explicit IR-unknown flag meanwhile
requirements.clearing_metric: a reserve/IR source with a URL, ingested for 32 teams

requirements.text: Reject: ranking strategies by season-long ROI
requirements.detail: Proposed alternative to SG-03: rank purely on realised return over the season.
requirements.clearing_metric: rejection recorded as policy: ranking uses benchmark-relative Brier skill with uncertainty; ROI enters only in stage-2 escrow after proper-score qualification

requirements.text: Archive weekly injury reports for past seasons (for Q06)
requirements.detail: Only way to test whether designations change outcomes
requirements.gate: no archive is reachable: nflverse/nfldata has no injury table (verified via GitHub contents API 2026-11-16); nflverse release assets fail from this environment (HTTP 000, recorded 2026-11-14)
requirements.clearing_metric: one archived season of weekly reports (>= 18 weeks x 32 clubs) with a source URL

requirements.text: Pre-register each strategy (definition frozen before results are seen)
requirements.detail: Prevents result-chasing
requirements.clearing_metric: the registry mechanism exists and is used: STRAT-1 frozen pre-kickoff with commit-hash registration

requirements.text: 2026 Kickoff & Declared Onside-Kick Regime Priors Filter
requirements.detail: Avoids systematic bias in originated game totals and 4th-quarter comeback win-probability curves.
requirements.gate: requires play-level or drive-level data for 2026 (kickoffs/onside declarations), which no reachable source provides
requirements.clearing_metric: play-level 2026 feed with kickoff events and declared onside attempts

requirements.text: Freeze a rule before it sees data (pre-registration)
requirements.detail: Commit the rule text, the sample window and the gates to git before the evaluation window opens. The commit hash is the registration.
requirements.clearing_metric: STRAT-1 method text, sample window (2026 W11+) and gates committed before the evaluation window opens; hash recorded in COORDINATION.md

requirements.text: Split data into train, validation and final holdout seasons
requirements.detail: Protects out-of-sample testing
requirements.gate: the walk-forward harness uses chronological out-of-sample splits (2011-2026, no-look-ahead audit); an explicit named train/validation/final-holdout table for future strategy runs is specified but not yet exercised
requirements.clearing_metric: a published split table (train/val/holdout seasons) used by the next strategy evaluation

requirements.text: Make suggestions on how to improve the site to improve decision making and create a section dedicated for suggestions so someone can review suggestions and choose the best path before implementing any changes.
requirements.detail: Sub-requirement: a clear list of questions, information and answers that need to be addressed before any decision, based on what we have and do not have; suggestions must discover missing information.
requirements.clearing_metric: suggestion sections with adopt/test/reject paths exist in four site layers, plus decision-question registers separating known / missing / how-to-discover
